svg.aria-label: self-healing-infra: an EC2 web server that repairs itself. A health metric is reported every minute; when nginx stops, a CloudWatch alarm invokes Lambda, which restarts nginx through Systems Manager. The drawing shows the metric dropping from 1 to 0, the alarm, the restart and the return to OK.

svg.text: one sample a minute · silence counts as a failure
An EC2 web server that repairs itself. A health check reports
to CloudWatch every minute; when nginx stops, or the
instance goes quiet, an alarm invokes Lambda, which restarts
nginx through Systems Manager. No SSH, nobody paged.
EC2 · CloudWatch · Lambda · Systems Manager · IAM · Terraform · Python
